boundary_cases.expected: rank=ceil(20*0.90)=18; calibrated radius is the 18th smallest score.
rank=ceil(9*0.90)=9>m; no finite conformal radius exists; return +infinity/null rather than silently using the sample maximum.
Use the inclusive score<=radius rule and the ordinary conservative order statistic.

boundary_cases.condition: finite-block population correction reaches or exceeds the metric support diameter
boundary_cases.expected: Declare the population ambiguity set vacuous (all distributions on the finite support); do not report a meaningful finite population radius.

round_trip_requirements: Preserve source fixture blob SHA metadata, service catalog and state encoding.
Preserve alpha, target coverage, block size, score definition and metric weights.
Preserve each calibration and development block identifier and unique source-family ID.
Preserve each forecast template reference and complete forecast distribution.
Preserve every observed state mask and recomputed empirical distribution.
Preserve every block nonconformity score and calibration rank.
Preserve the unbounded-radius/null state when the conformal rank exceeds calibration sample count.
Preserve the guarantee boundary and exchangeability assumptions.
Preserve separate calibration and development splits without moving any block.
Preserve unknown namespaced extension fields losslessly.
Preserve the within-block sampling assumption, delta, finite-state TV bound, W1 correction and combined confidence lower bound.
Preserve the explicit vacuity result when the corrected population radius reaches the support diameter.

conformance_targets.population_correction: finite-state TV concentration plus metric-diameter conversion; population-level correction must report vacuity at or above support diameter

limitations: Fixture values are synthetic, public-development-only and not independently custodied.
Block exchangeability is a protocol assumption, not something the evaluator can prove from IDs.
Coverage is marginal over calibration and the future block; it is not conditional on the realized calibration sample.
The calibrated score concerns an empirical block distribution, not the unknown population distribution.
Arbitrary temporal, structural or evidence shift can invalidate exchangeability.
This module calibrates a radius; it does not train a forecasting model or loss-aware transport metric.
